transcript: mera order kestral k seven smartphone 256 gigabytes parsu deliver hua kitne din tak return kar sakti hoon
transcript_hi: मेरा ऑर्डर कैस्ट्रिल के सेवन स्मार्टफ़ोन 256 गीगाबाइट्स पार्सल डिलीवर हुआ, कितने दिन तक रिटर्न कर सकती हूँ?
reply: Hello, main ZentroMart ka AI support assistant hoon. Kestrel K7 smartphone jaise electronics items ke liye return window delivery ke din se 7 days ki hoti hai. Aapka order 18 October 2026 ko deliver hua tha, isliye aap ise 7 days, yaani 25 October 2026 tak return kar sakte hain.

retrieved.label: CURRENT POLICY
retrieved.text:
The return window starts on the **delivery date** and is counted in calendar days. The category of every product is listed in the `return_category` column of the product catalog.

| Category | Return window | Catalog code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Electronics and accessories | 7 days | `electronics` |
| Clothing, footwear and bags | 15 days | `fashion` |
| Home, kitchen and furniture | 10 days | `home_kitchen` |
| Beauty and personal care (unopened, seal intact) | 7 days | `beauty_sealed` |
| Books and stationery | 10 days | `books_media` |
| Grocery, fresh and perishables | Not returnable | `grocery` |
| Innerwear, lingerie and swimwear | Not returnable | `innerwear` |
| Gift cards and digital codes | Not returnable | `digital` |

retrieved.label: CURRENT POLICY
retrieved.text: Return windows, reverse pickup and refunds are the same for every seller and are handled by ZentroMart.

retrieved.label: CURRENT POLICY
retrieved.text: Clothing, footwear and bags from orders **placed between 01 October and 15 October 2026** can be returned within 30 days of delivery. All other categories follow the normal windows in RET-2.

retrieved.label: CURRENT POLICY
retrieved.text: From **1 August 2026**, the return window for electronics and accessories is 7 days. Electronics **delivered before 1 August 2026** keep the earlier 10-day window from version 3 of this policy.

retrieved.label: SUPERSEDED POLICY (applies only where the current policy says so, e.g. RET-3)
retrieved.text: Reverse pickup is free for all returns.
